```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
source(here("01_functions","functions.R"))

# for correlation analyses
library(car)
library(GGally)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpmisc)
```

# RONI index

```{r}
# Read into a tiblle
csv <- read_csv(here("00_data", "raw", "roni.csv"))

colnames(csv)

roni <- csv |>
  rename(
    date = 1,
    roni = 2
  ) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    roni = na_if(roni, -9999)
  )|> 
  filter(
    date >= as.Date("2020-10-01"), 
    date < as.Date("2024-11-01")
  )
  

roni

ggplot(roni, aes(date,roni))+
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    date_breaks = "3 months",
    date_minor_breaks = "1 month"
    ) + 
    annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date("2023-07-01"), xmax = as.Date("2024-02-01"), ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,         alpha = .2
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-07-01"), y = 1.5, label = "El Niño"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Date", 
      y = "Relative Oceanic Niño Index (°C)") +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) 
  

#----------------------------------
# filter rone above 0.5
roni_05 <- roni |>
  filter(roni >=0.5)
```

# Climate data

```{r}
# ERA 5 Tair at 2m at 13:30 and 01:30 solar time
temp <- read_csv(here("00_data","processed", "t2m_1330_0130_solar_time.csv"))
temp

# Total Precipitation - monthly mean
precip <- read_csv(here("00_data","processed", "monthly_total_precip.csv"))
precip

# Surface short-wave (solar) radiation downwards at 13:30 solar time (ssrd taken for the hour before)
ssrd <- read_csv(here("00_data","processed", "ssrd_1330_solar_time.csv"))
ssrd

```

# LST data

```{r}
monthly_lst <- read_csv(
  here("03_results", "lst_cooling_monthly_mean.csv"),
  col_types = cols(
  solar_time = col_character(),
  .default = col_guess()
  ))

monthly_lst$month_date <- as.Date(monthly_lst$month_date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")

monthly_lst

```

# Join RONI and Climate data and LST

```{r}
# join with the roni table
full <- roni |>
  full_join(temp, by = "date") |>
  full_join(monthly_lst, by = join_by("date" == "month_date")) |>
  full_join(precip, by = "date") |>
  full_join(ssrd, by = "date")

full <- full |> mutate(
  # add temperature in a single column corresponding to the solar time
  air_temp_2m = case_when(
    solar_time == "13:30" ~ t1330,
    solar_time == "01:30" ~ t0130,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ),
  # remove incoming solar radiation for nightime data
  ssrd_Wm2_1330 = if_else(
      solar_time == "01:30",
      NA_real_,
      ssrd_Wm2_1330
    ),
  ssrd_Jm2_1330 = if_else(
      solar_time == "01:30",
      NA_real_,
      ssrd_Wm2_1330
    )
) |>
  rename(lst_forest = forest,
         lst_open_land = open_land) |>
  select(!c(t1330,t0130))

full

write_csv(
  full, 
  here("03_results", "lst_and_climate_var_monthly_mean.csv")
  )
```

## Plot join

```{r}

full <- read_csv(
  here("03_results", "lst_and_climate_var_monthly_mean.csv"),
  col_types = cols(
  solar_time = col_character(),
  .default = col_guess()
  ))

full

# -------------
# First restructure the data
df_long <- full |>
  # select(c(precipitation_mm, roni, ssrd_Wm2_1330, t1330, lst_mean, cooling)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    # cols = c(precipitation_mm, roni, ssrd_Wm2_1330, t1330, lst_mean, cooling),
    cols = c(precipitation_mm, roni, ssrd_Wm2_1330, air_temp_2m, lst_mean, cooling),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )|>
  select(c(date, year, month, solar_time, variable, value))

df_long

# --------------------
# Factor the variables, to define the order they will appear in the plot
df_long$variable <- factor(
  df_long$variable,
  # levels = c("precipitation_mm", "roni", "ssrd_Wm2_1330", "t1330", "lst_mean", "cooling")
  levels = c("precipitation_mm", "roni", "ssrd_Wm2_1330", "air_temp_2m", "lst_mean", "cooling")
)

# Change the names for the plot
df_long$variable <- dplyr::recode(df_long$variable,
                           # t1330 = "Air Temperature (°C)", #at 13:30 local solar time
                           air_temp_2m = "Air Temperature (°C)", #at 01:30 local solar time
                           roni = "Relative Oceanic Niño Index (°C)",
                           precipitation_mm = "Precipitation (mm)",
                           lst_mean = "Land Surface Temperature (°C)", #at 13:30 local solar time
                           ssrd_Wm2_1330 = "Downward short-wave solar radiation (W m⁻²)", #at 13:30 local solar time
                        
                           cooling = "Forest-induced cooling (°C)")


# Then plot with facet wrap
ggplot(df_long |> filter(solar_time == "13:30"), aes(date, value)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    date_breaks = "3 months",
    date_minor_breaks = "1 month"
    ) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date("2023-07-01"), xmax = as.Date("2024-03-01"), ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = .2
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1)
```

```{r}
df <- read_csv(
  here("03_results", "lst_and_climate_var_monthly_mean.csv"),
  col_types = cols(
  solar_time = col_character(),
  .default = col_guess()
  ))


# Create a group variable
df$period <- ifelse(df$date >= "2023-03-01" & df$date <= "2024-04-30",
                    "El Niño period",
                    "Other months") |>

# Column labels
variable_labels <- c(
  "air_temp_2m" = "Air temperature (°C)",
  "precipitation_mm" = "Precipitation (mm)",
  "ssrd_Wm2_1330" = "Solar radiation (W/m²)"
)

# Row labels
time_labels <- c(
  "13:30" = "Daytime",
  "01:30" = "Nighttime"
)

# -------------------------
df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(air_temp_2m, precipitation_mm, ssrd_Wm2_1330),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    solar_time = factor(solar_time, levels = c("13:30", "01:30"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = value,
    y = cooling
  )) +
  geom_point(aes(color = period),alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "El Niño period" = "#FF4500",
      "Other months" = "#365F53"
    )
  )+
  geom_smooth(
    color = "grey40",
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    level = 0.95,
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(solar_time),
    cols = vars(variable),
    scales = "free_x",
    labeller = labeller(
      variable = as_labeller(variable_labels),
      solar_time = as_labeller(time_labels)
   ))+
    stat_poly_eq(
      formula = y ~ x,
      aes(label = paste(
        after_stat(rr.label),
        after_stat(eq.label),
        sep = "\n"
      )),
      output.type = "text",
      parse = FALSE,
      label.x = 0.05,
      label.y = 0.05,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0,
      size = 3
    ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Forest cooling (°C)",
    color = "Period"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
# -------------------------------------


```
